comparison.objective: Load and stack four loose blanks in a narrow vertical magazine; candidate transfers one uncaged bearing block across a rail–jig junction while preserving its balls.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests repeated yaw alignment and top insertion of independent rigid blanks. Candidate tests bimanual end-face mating, continuous race support, and alignment-preserving sliding of a recirculating assembly.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires four flat, centred, supported blanks at rest without mouth jams. Candidate requires a completely transferred block, intact four-row ball containment, continuous support, no contamination or damage, and released stability.
comparison.reason: Narrow insertion is shared, but the record does not test maintaining a physical support continuum for free rolling elements during transfer.
